## Current positions

- **Senior Researcher in Economics (DR1), INRAE**, member of BETA in Nancy.
- **President, FAERE** — French Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, since 2023.
- **Expert in socio-economic analysis, ANSES**, since 2022.
- **Scientific Director, Observatory for the Economy of the Forest (OLEF)**, since 2020.
- **Executive Board member, ARTEMIS** interdisciplinary programme on forest socio-ecological systems.
- **Associate Editor, Annals of Forest Science**, since 2025.

## Previous positions

- **2018–2022** · Deputy Director, BETA.
- **2013–2017** · Director, Laboratory of Forest Economics (LEF).
- **2005–2017** · Research Scientist / Senior Researcher, INRA–LEF, Nancy.
- **2002–2005** · Contract Researcher, ENGREF, Montpellier.
- **2001–2002** · Postdoctoral Researcher, CIRANO, Montreal.
- **2000–2001** · Teaching and Research Fellow, Toulouse I University.

## Education and qualifications

- **2024** · Qualification for Full Professor positions, French CNU, Section 05 — Economics.
- **2011** · Habilitation to Supervise Research (HDR), Toulouse I Capitole University.
- **2001** · PhD in Economics, Toulouse I University.
- **1999** · European Diploma in Advanced Quantitative Economics (DEEQA), Toulouse I University.
- **1996** · Postgraduate diploma in Environmental, Natural Resource, Energy and Agricultural Economics, Toulouse I University.

## Research profile

- 43 articles in peer-reviewed journals since 2001.
- h-index 25 and i10-index 36 (Google Scholar, Aug. 2026).
- 11 completed PhD theses supervised or co-supervised.
- Research interests: environmental and natural resource economics, microeconomics, applied econometrics, forests, ecosystem services, biodiversity and water.
